base:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE exquisite high-fidelity 16:9 landscape full-screen PC Cold War collectible card battle UI concept, at least 1920x1080 quality. This is a NEW expanded concept using the provided reference images. Image 1 is visual style reference A: worn Berlin concrete tactical map, gray with orange controls. Image 2 is visual style reference B: khaki Vietnam map table, warm jungle light and vintage equipment. Image 3 is CARD ANATOMY reference: left-top deployment + action cost badge and rectangular military unit card with attack/type/defense. Image 4 is ORDER CARD anatomy reference: single deployment cost, exclamation point, name and effect text. Keep their aged cream cardstock and original painted military art but replace all WWII subjects by the historically appropriate Cold War theater specified below. DO NOT copy WWII vehicles, names, flags or logos from the card references.

CRITICAL GAMEPLAY GRAPHICS, must be visible:
Every UNIT card has one compact DARK cost badge at top-left exactly structured as a LARGE ivory deployment number on the LEFT (about 70% of badge width), a tiny gold 'K' at upper-right, and a clearly readable SMALL amber action number at LOWER-RIGHT within the SAME badge. Example deployment 4, action 2 should visually read large '4' beside small 'K' above small '2', not a fraction and not 42. Unit art below a short title; separate bottom combat stats are attack / unit silhouette / defense, NEVER confuse these with costs.
Every ORDER / SKILL card has ONLY a single LARGE deployment number plus tiny K at top-left; NO small action number anywhere, NO attack/defense row; use a small square '!' separator, Chinese title and one short effect sentence. Orders are hand cards, not deployed units.
UI resource is shared '指挥点 6/9', not a separate action-point bank. Right or lower-right end-turn button '结束回合'. Include small precise legend '大数字：部署费用  ·  小数字：行动费用'. On the right a large fully visible hover card INSPECTOR occupying 21% screen width, tall and large enough to read; make cost badge and action cost very clear. Add two restrained external callouts '部署费用' and '行动费用' pointing to correct respective large/small digits on the inspected unit. Costs and stats are game design examples.
Main board occupying other 75%: opponent HQ health 20 and four face-down cards at top; 2-3 enemy units upper support row; central '前线' band with two friendly units ONLY; 2 friendly units lower support row; five visible hand cards at bottom with at least two ORDER cards visibly lacking secondary costs and combat stats; player HQ health 18 lower-left. Clearly organized battle screen, flat near-orthographic camera, card interaction hierarchy. Card faces remain largest focal area. Show proper portrait proportions around 2:3 in inspected and hand cards.
Premium warm paper textures, painterly equipment art, muted tactical palette and rich but restrained tabletop objects cropped to perimeter. Chinese short labels with clear spacing, no long filler copy, no quotes or propaganda slogans, no modern weapons or sci-fi holograms. One small concept index top-left. All generated card art original. No KARDS logo.

factions.note: 跨年代游戏阵营暂定分组；每副牌统一使用所选卡背。

variants.name: 柏林危机 · 检查站
variants.detail: CONCEPT 11 / "柏林危机" / "1961 · 查理检查站". Extend Image 1 with strong Cold War urban espionage identity. Cold graphite concrete map table, damp Berlin city-plan print, chipped off-white paint, muted rust-orange controls. Perimeter props: red-white checkpoint barrier crop, 1961 border transit papers and checkpoint stamp, Minox B miniature spy camera, compact reel-to-reel tape recorder, olive field telephone and folded Berlin street map; do not crowd. Early Cold War armor only: opposing T-54 tanks and motor rifle units; friendly M48 Patton and M113. NO T-72, BMP, Abrams, attack drones or 1980s helicopters. Inspector: tall complete "M48 巴顿" unit card, cost badge LARGE 4 / small action 2, attack 4 defense 5, tiny tank silhouette, text "装甲 1". Hand includes single-cost order "边境封锁" cost 2 effect "压制一个敌方地面单位。" and "情报截获" cost 1 effect "抽一张牌。" Both orders show ! and no small number or combat stats. A subtle checkpoint silhouette printed into the frontline, gray day light with a warm desk lamp. Original design more detailed and authentic than Image 1, legibility remains paramount.

variants.name: 越南战场 · 空中机动
variants.detail: CONCEPT 12 / "越南战场" / "1968 · 空中机动". Extend Image 2's warm khaki jungle field command tabletop, damp green canvas and worn topographic map. Authentic perimeter props: PRC-25 backpack radio with handset, olive canteen, US dog tags, grease pencil, folded helicopter landing-zone acetate overlay, zippo-style lighter WITHOUT brand mark, compass and weathered field notebook. Warm dappled jungle sunlight only at edges. Original card art: UH-1D Huey with TWO main rotor blades, M48 Patton, M113, MiG-21, North Vietnamese infantry with AK-47, US infantry with M16A1. Inspector: tall "UH-1D 休伊" card, big deployment 3 / small action 1, attack 2 defense 3, helicopter silhouette, effect "部署：使一个友军获得 +1 防御。". Hand orders: "近距空援" cost 3, effect "对一个地面单位造成 3 点伤害。" and "丛林伏击" cost 2, effect "压制一个敌方单位。". Orders use ! and no action cost or combat values. Dusty amber button, no post-1968 weapons, no Afghanistan or European props. Playable sharp UI with large readable cost badge on inspected card.

variants.name: 古巴危机 · 十三天
variants.detail: CONCEPT 13 / "古巴危机" / "1962 · 十三天". Expand the gray and khaki tactile military style into a Caribbean reconnaissance-and-naval-quarantine command table. Desaturated teal Gulf of Mexico/Cuba nautical paper map, aged cream cards, graphite steel trim and discreet amber-red warning lamps. Period-correct October 1962 props: black-and-white U-2 aerial photo strips showing missile sites, photographic loupe, slide rule, folded reconnaissance report, black rotary telephone, teletype paper, small film canister. NO red Moscow-Washington hotline phone: hotline came later; no modern screens. Cards show U-2 spy plane, F-8 Crusader, R-12 missile transporter as a static background illustration, Foxtrot submarine, period destroyer and Cuban infantry. Do not depict a nuclear strike or actual battle outcome; this is a stylized fictional crisis game scenario. Inspector: "U-2 侦察机" unit, deployment large 3 / action small 1, attack 1 defense 3, aircraft silhouette, effect "部署：抽一张牌。". Hand orders: "海上隔离" single cost 3, effect "本回合敌方增援费用 +1。" and "航拍证据" single cost 1, effect "抽一张牌。". Both show !, no action/attack/defense. Thin blockade route on background map, not a huge illustrative ocean scene. Extraordinary period-object detail, clean mechanical UI and clearly distinct unit-vs-order anatomy.

variants.name: 朝鲜战争 · 冰雪战线
variants.detail: CONCEPT 14 / "朝鲜战争" / "1951 · 冰雪战线". Cold gray-blue weathered command desk lined with faded olive wool, topographic Korean peninsula map, aged cream cards and restrained faded red/blue markers. Snow and frost only on perimeter, all card faces dry and readable. Authentic 1951 objects: EE-8 leather field telephone, SCR-300 radio edge, military enamel mug, folded paper situation report, wool gloves, analog compass and simple contour-map ruler. Original painted cards of T-34-85, M26 Pershing, F-86 Sabre, MiG-15, Chinese infantry with period rifles and US infantry with M1 rifles; WWII-origin equipment IS appropriate here because used in Korea, NO T-72, M16, MiG-21 or helicopters from Vietnam era. Inspector "M26 潘兴" big deployment 4 / small action 2, attack 4 defense 5, tank silhouette, text "装甲 1". Hand orders "炮火准备" single cost 3 effect "对一个地面单位造成 3 点伤害。" and "冬季补给" single cost 2 effect "恢复总部 3 点防御。". ! and no action or combat stats on orders. Blue-gray tactical board with soft cold daylight and a single warm lamp, rigorous card rows, pristine information hierarchy.

variants.name: 阿富汗战场 · 山地补给
variants.detail: CONCEPT 15 / "阿富汗战场" / "1987 · 山地补给". Tactile sand-beige Soviet mountain field command map, dusty olive ammunition-crate wood edges, muted terracotta contour lines, cream cards and weathered orange UI. Perimeter period objects: Soviet R-159 field radio, olive military canteen with cloth cover, folded mountain reconnaissance photo, grease-pencil route overlay, 35mm film case, stamped supply manifest and mechanical wristwatch. Original card art: Mi-24 Hind, BMP-2, T-62, Mi-8 transport helicopter, Soviet mountain infantry and distant generic irregular infantry; no modern rail-mounted rifles or drones. Inspector "米-24 雌鹿" with large deployment 5 / small action 2, attack 4 defense 5, helicopter icon, rule "空中支援". Orders "空中补给" single cost 2 effect "抽两张牌。" and "山地伏击" single cost 2 effect "压制一个敌方地面单位。". No secondary numbers or combat stat row on orders. Warm dusty light, subdued illustrated mountains printed in frontline band, handsome analog map-room feel extending Vietnam canvas style. Clear unit card cost/attack/defense separation.

variants.name: 富尔达缺口 · 装甲对峙
variants.detail: CONCEPT 16 / "富尔达缺口" / "1985 · 假想推演". This is explicitly a fictional Cold War confrontation scenario, not an actual historical battle. Extend Berlin concrete/steel tactical table style into a rainy Central European command bunker. Dark olive-gray gridded German topographic map, ivory unit cards, amber mechanical controls. Perimeter 1985 objects: folded Bundeswehr/NATO map, acetate grease-pencil operational overlay, analog field telephone, cassette recorder, mechanical stopwatch, paper codebook, small amber CRT terminal corner. Keep everything off central play area. Card illustrations: T-72A, BMP-2, Leopard 2A4, M1A1 Abrams 1985, MiG-23, F-4 Phantom and 1980s mechanized infantry. Inspector "豹 2A4" deployment LARGE 6 / action SMALL 2, attack 6 defense 6, tank icon, rule "装甲 1". Orders "电子干扰" single cost 2 effect "本回合敌方行动费用 +1。" and "烟幕掩护" single cost 1 effect "使一个友军获得烟幕。". Orders show ! and only one cost. Crisp pale-green active-unit outline, expensive yet restrained tactile game art, both costs absolutely legible on every visible unit.

variants.name: 单位牌 · 双费用规范
variants.detail:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-resolution 16:9 landscape military card-game UNIT CARD DESIGN PRESENTATION, not a battle screen. Four input references: Image 1 and 2 are user's chosen Berlin concrete and Vietnam canvas art direction. Image 3 is authoritative anatomy reference for the compact dual cost badge; Image 4 is order style context only. Create three large, fully visible portrait UNIT cards centered side-by-side, no overlap, all same size, nearly full frame height, circa 350px wide and 560px tall, with adequate header and footer space. Premium near-orthographic flat lay on very subdued split graphite concrete / khaki field map. Minimal cropped spy-camera and compass at edges only. Aged ivory cardboard, clean military stencil/sans typography, original highly detailed gouache Cold War equipment art. Every UNIT cost badge at top left: LARGE ivory deployment digit on LEFT (70% badge), tiny amber K top-right, smaller amber action digit lower-right. Both numbers within SAME dark rectangular badge. The large digit and the small digit must not read as a single number or fraction. Upper-right country roundel. Short card title at header. Large painted image occupying upper 58%; distinct bottom stat row attack / unit silhouette / defense; below that a short effect and one tiny rarity marker.
Card 1: US "M48 巴顿", deployment large 4 action small 2, attack4 tank silhouette defense5, rule "装甲 1". Card2: US "UH-1D 休伊", deployment large3 action small1, attack2 helicopter silhouette defense3, rule "部署：使一个友军获得 +1 防御。". Illustration accurate two-blade main rotor Huey in Vietnam. Card3: USSR "T-72A", deployment large5 action small2, attack5 tank silhouette defense5, rule "装甲 1".
Main title small top-left "17 / 单位牌 · 双费用". A thin external callout above card1 points at LARGE 4: "部署费用：打出时支付". A different external callout at its small 2: "行动费用：每次移动或攻击支付". Along bottom under cards a precise legend "费用与攻防分开显示" and example "已部署且可行动：移动 2 + 攻击 2 = 4 指挥点". Do not imply units can act the turn deployed. Keep all three cards fully in frame with clear margin. No order cards, no extra unit cards, no battlefield UI, no arbitrary slogans, no fantasy. This is a meticulous portfolio-quality card component design sheet. Exact numeric values and action badges are the priority.

variants.name: 指令与技能 · 单费用
variants.detail:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exquisite high fidelity 16:9 landscape Cold War ORDER / SKILL card design sheet. Input image1 Berlin and image2 Vietnam are tactile paper-military styles. Input image4 is the key order card anatomy reference; image3 shows a UNIT card only as contrast, do not copy its dual costs or combat stats. Four equal portrait order cards in one horizontal row, completely visible, no overlap, large enough to read, on a subdued dark concrete and khaki classified-file tabletop. Original Cold War painterly artworks, aged ivory stock, thin charcoal header outlines and gold accent. Very little scenery, 85% layout devoted to cards. Top heading "18 / 指令与战术技能". Small explanatory subtitle "均为一次性效果，仅支付部署费用".
ABSOLUTE priority: Each of these FOUR non-unit cards has ONLY ONE single large deployment digit plus a tiny K in top-left dark badge. NO tiny secondary action digit. NO attack/defense numbers, NO unit silhouettes or bottom combat-stat row. Large illustration dominates upper 60%, then central small square !, title, and short effect sentence. Numbers inside effect text are fine. Short category label near bottom either "指令 · ORDER" or "战术技能 · TACTIC".
From left to right exactly:
1. Cost 3K; title "近距空援"; art F-4 Phantom jets over a Vietnam valley with muted dust/smoke; effect "对一个地面单位造成 3 点伤害。"; type "指令 · ORDER".
2. Cost 1K; title "情报截获"; art 1960s intelligence officer in headphones listening to a reel-to-reel recorder and radio; effect "抽一张牌。"; type "战术技能 · TACTIC".
3. Cost 2K; title "电子干扰"; art 1980s mobile radar truck and electronic warfare operator in analog console light; effect "本回合敌方行动费用 +1。"; type "战术技能 · TACTIC".
4. Cost 2K; title "空中补给"; art UH-1 Huey and cargo crates at jungle landing zone; effect "抽两张牌。"; type "指令 · ORDER".
Small bottom legend "单费用徽标   /   ! 效果标记   /   无攻防栏". No extra cards, no battle UI, no irrelevant explanation text, no persuasive slogans, no made-up modern futuristic gear. Rich readable military illustration quality, impeccable card alignment, no clipped lower edges. UI concept values are original design placeholders.

variants.name: 西方阵营 · 四国卡背
variants.detail:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-end 16:9 landscape card-back and national emblem design presentation for a Cold War military card game. Input image1 Berlin concrete and image2 Vietnam canvas establish tactile military collectible-card material language. Ignore card FRONT anatomy in image3 and image4: this sheet contains only BACKS. Four equal fully visible tall 2:3 portrait CARD BACKS side by side in ONE row, each about 320px wide with clean spacing. All share the exact same border and layout; national central medallions vary. Premium deep navy dyed paper, olive-gray linen inset, restrained aged brass/gold hot-stamped linework, fine military map grid and very subtle security-print guilloche (not ornate casino style). Double rectangular corner-clipped border and small original four-point compass/star WESTERN FACTION mark at top and inverted bottom. Each back center has an exquisitely legible large game-stylized national heraldic crest. The four cards LEFT TO RIGHT:
USA: golden bald eagle with spread wings, striped shield and a small star arrangement, game-inspired heraldry.
UNITED KINGDOM: crowned heraldic lion with a Union-Jack shield.
FRANCE: dignified Gallic rooster in a laurel medallion, restrained blue-white-red enamel accents.
WEST GERMANY 1949-1990: black Federal eagle in a gold escutcheon, small black-red-gold ribbon.
No Nazi symbols, no WWII German iron cross, no post-reunification fictional insignia. These are game adaptations, not a claim to be exact official seals.
Top restrained header "19 / 西方阵营 · 卡背与徽章". Each card name only OUTSIDE beneath card: "美国 USA", "英国 UK", "法国 FRANCE", "西德 FRG". Under each label add a small matching extracted emblem sample to make the national badge easy to inspect. Back surfaces themselves show emblems and pattern only; absolutely no cost digits, attack values, weapon illustrations or unit names. Quiet worn gray concrete tabletop backing with a cropped compass and 1960s map edge, soft side light, tactile paper not shiny 3D metal slabs. All four card backs consistent dimensions, flat straight-on camera, complete unclipped corners. Sophisticated restrained Cold War graphic design.

variants.name: 东方阵营 · 四国卡背
variants.detail:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-end 16:9 landscape card-back and national emblem design presentation for a Cold War military card game. Input image1 Berlin concrete and image2 Vietnam canvas establish tactile military collectible-card material language. Ignore card front mechanics from image3 and image4; ONLY CARD BACKS and emblem samples here. Four equal fully visible tall 2:3 portrait card backs in ONE row, each about 320px wide, clean spacing, same dimensions and shared exact layout. Shared EASTERN FACTION design family: dark oxblood / maroon dyed paper with deep olive woven inset and restrained aged gold hot stamping, precise double rectangular geometric border, tiny original five-point star with two wheat sprigs at top and inverted bottom, very fine radial map security lines. Premium collectible printed paper rather than literal steel or gaudy casino decks. Distinct dominant central national medallions in gold and very controlled enamel color. Four LEFT TO RIGHT:
USSR: five-point star above hammer-and-sickle globe surrounded by wheat, Soviet-era inspired game emblem.
VIETNAM: one large gold five-point star on a red field, surrounded by gold rice stalks, with a cogwheel and red ribbon at bottom. No gate or four smaller stars.
EAST GERMANY / GDR: hammer and compass in rye wreath, restrained black-red-gold ribbon, unmistakably distinct from West German eagle.
CUBA: a shield with golden key over blue sea, palm tree and mountains, red-white-blue ribbon, no eagle or Soviet hammer emblem.
These are stylized national game insignia, not claims of exact official seals or of treaty membership across every decade. Top title "20 / 东方阵营 · 卡背与徽章". Under each back ONLY outside the card, clear label "苏联 USSR", "越南 VIETNAM", "东德 GDR", "古巴 CUBA". Below each label a small matching separate badge sample. A small footer "跨年代游戏分组" if room, no political messaging or slogans.
Back surfaces show only crest, border and pattern. ABSOLUTELY no cost digits, unit stats, unit names, frontline, card fronts or weapon art. Muted khaki military cloth and worn Berlin gray tabletop background, subtle field-map corners, clean soft directional light. Equal aligned cards with all corners visible and generous negative space, strong emblem silhouette at thumbnail size.
